covered.rule: §1 Say the opening verbatim from section 7 and then the holder question
§1 at most two asks total; if still unclear close cr-unreached/cr-r-unclear
§1 never say arrears, overdue, balance or payment before security passes
§1 A relative cannot verify or promise for the holder
§1.1 birth_date, date, numeric MDY
§1.2 access_pin, exactly 6 digits, leading zeros
§1.3 locality_word, text
§1 Four wrong answers TOTAL ... cr-unverified/cr-r-failed; count in agent code; no remaining-count
§1 No format hints or free hint retries exist
§1 "Please use the verification desk before another call."
§1 Explain once on refusal; second refusal cr-unverified/cr-r-declined; purpose question not a refusal
§2 Callback today or next business day, 08:45–17:15, strictly later than now, ask once more
§2 cr-unreached/cr-r-no-callback, cr-unreached/cr-r-callback
§2 Wrong number cr-unreached/cr-r-wrong-number
§2 death: "Please accept our sympathy." cr-unreached/cr-r-deceased
§3 At most 1 products (also maxItems 1 in API)
§3 State all products first; ask today once; per-product attempt counter
§3 table: cr-flex flexible credit flex_base; cr-term term advance term_base
§3 Business days Mon–Fri except 2026-10-23, 2026-11-02, 2026-12-25
§3 Next weekday = following week; missing date parts clarified
CR-D1 days 1–60, EARLIER of 6th business day and last business day of month
CR-D1 deadline before today: no promise, cr-none/cr-r-refused
CR-D1 one subsequent full-by-deadline offer, floor only if full already refused
§4 dates today or later, business days, roll forward within deadline, vague clarify once
§4 Common dates adjusted per product
CR-A1 effective floor min(full, max(base, ceil 25%))
§5 full first, never ask amount, floor once, "The unpaid remainder stays overdue.", accept floor..full
§5 Today is an allowed date
§6 "May I save this arrangement?" batch read-back
§6 At most one saved promise per product; one extra retry
§6 Changes to successful promises use section 7 sentence
§6 already paid: sentence, cr-paid no reason
§6 dispute incl. historical payoff: cr-none/cr-r-disputed
§6 hardship: sympathy sentence, care desk offer cr-routed/cr-r-care, declined cr-none/cr-r-distress
§6 contract/instalment change: cr-plan-desk cr-routed/cr-r-replan
§6 human request: cr-human-desk cr-routed/cr-r-person, no help offer
§6 scam: scam_reply and continue
§6 refusal to talk: ask once then cr-none/cr-r-refused
§6 Transfer overrides, preserves saved promises, no notes; precedence; goodbye before close_call
§6 Notes disabled; register: no add_note calls authorized
§7 sentence table (opening .. recorded_promise_change_reply)
Disposition register outcomes/reasons
Queues cr-plan-desk, cr-human-desk, cr-care-desk

fixed: Removed unresolved entry 'identity.wrong_count': the document settles it (count in agent code, 4 total) and it is already expressed by identity.wrong_count_source='code' and wrong_answer_limit=4.
Added 'A relative cannot verify or promise for the holder.' to third_party.source so that rule is traceable.
Extended amounts.source and promise_write.source with the below-floor, no-discount, consent-revalidation and service-failure sentences for traceability; no values changed.
Verified all other values against the specification and openapi enums (verify_identity field, close_call outcome/reason, transfer_to_agent queue, contract_kind); no value errors found.
unresolved: CR-D1 deadline is the earlier of two rules (6th business day vs last business day of current month); the DSL has no min-of-two, encoded with extra 'cap'/'combine' keys the compiler must honour.
Deadline-before-today case (no promise, close cr-none/cr-r-refused) has no IR field.
Effective floor combines a base field, a 25% rule rounded up to the cent, and a cap at full; the floor_rules DSL cannot express it natively, encoded with extra keys.
